༄༅/kha byang 'od gsal snying po bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ kha byang 'od gsal snying po bzhugs so/ /

kha byang 'od gsal snying po zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab cing rgya che mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /mkhyen brtse'i klu dbang yid bzhin rnam grol gter/ /thugs rje'i dus rlabs srid zhi'i dbyings khyab pa'i/ /rgyal ba sngon med gang can mtsho la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' gsang rgya che las/ /nges pa'i snying po sku gsum 'od gsal lam/ /gsang ba snying tig yi ge grangs mang las/ /yang tig yid bzhin nor bu gsal bar bya/ /shin tu yang zab gnad rnams 'dir bsdus pa/ /bla med gdengs can mtshan mchog thub pa yi/ /yang zab mngon byung gsal bar bstan pa la/ /lo rgyus sprin tshogs skor gsum dbang rnams dang*/ /rgya mtsho skor gsum don khrid skor gsum dang*/ /rgyab yig skor gsum yang yig skor gsum dang*/ /sprin phung skor gsum sgron me skor gsum dang*/ /bdud rtsi skor gsum 'khor lo skor gsum dang*/ /gegs sel skor gsum nor bu skor gsum dang*/ /snying po skor gsum me long skor gsum dang*/ /snyan brgyud skor gsum spu gri skor gsum ste/ /'di dag rnams kyis don gnyis phun tshogs byed/ /de dag so so'i dgos byed bstan pa ni/ /legs par bshad kyis rab tu yid la zung*/ /lo rgyus chen mo rin chen phreng ba yis/ /nges pa'i bka' la ngo mtshar yid ches bstan/ /sprin tshogs skor gsum dngos grub chu bo 'grub/ /brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin rlabs sprin tshogs kyis/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen lhun gyis grub/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis/ /byin rlabs tshad med rtogs pa brgyud la skye/ / maṇḍal 'bul chog tshogs gnyis sprin tshogs kyis/ /tshogs gnyis sgrib byang sku gsum lam la reg /de yi phyir na kun gyi sngon 'gro'i gnad/ /'di dag gces pas rtag tu brtson par bya/ /dbang chog skor bzhis skal ldan smin par byed/

/gnad yig rnam bzhes ma tshang kha skong byed/ /spros bcas bum dbang rdo rje'i sku thob cing*/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel don la dbang bar byed/ /de yi gnad yig ming gi rigs byed kyis/ /ye shes rigs lnga'i ming rnams gsal bar byed/ /spros med gsang dbang rdo rje'i dbang thob cing*/ / ye shes drod 'babs ye shes 'khor lo'i dbang*/ /de yi gnad yig ye shes dbab pa yis/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs thob/ /shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje'i thugs thob bde chen don la sbyor/ /de yi gnad yig gling bzhi rgyan gyur gyis/ /sku bzhi ye shes nyi shu lnga la spyod/ / rab tu spros med tshig dbang rin po ches/ /ye shes don thob gdod ma'i zad sar phyin/ /de yi gnad yig yid bzhin dra ba yis/ /tshogs gnyis lhun rdzogs sku gsum zhing la spyod/ /de yi phyir na gzhi nyid smin par byed/ /dbang gi chu bos dang por rgyud sbyangs gces/ /rgya mtsho skor gsum dngos grub myur du thob/ /dam tshig rim pa rnam grol rgya mtsho yis/ /spang blangs mtshams phyed rang rgyud dag par byed/ /tshogs mchod rim pa yid bzhin rgya mtsho yis/ / tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /bla ma'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho yis/ /byin rlabs tshad med rtogs pa rgyud la 'char/ /de yi phyir na 'di dag shin tu gces/ /don khrid skor gsum smin rjais grol bar byed/ /sngon 'gro sems sbyong bdun gyi don khrid kyis/ /gdod ma'i don la 'jug pa'i rkang stegs byed/ /dngos gzhi'i 'od gsal snying po'i don khrid kyis/ /bde gshegs snying po'i don la dngos su sbyor/ khregs chod ye babs sor gzhag don khrid kyis/ /gshis kyi ngang der mthar 'dzin sgro 'dogs gcod/ /de yi phyir na 'di dag snying dang 'dra/ /rgyab yig skor gsum nyams len yid ches bskyed/

khregs chod rgyab yig nam mkha' dri med kyis/ /rtsa bral gnyis med re dogs bral bar byed/ /thod rgal rgyab yig nyi zla gza' skar gyis/ /'od gsal rang snang gong 'phel btsan sa zin/ /btags grol rgyab yig yid bzhin lhun grub kyis/ /mngon sum gong 'phel bar dor grol ba'i grogs/ /de yi phyir na 'di dag shin tu gces/ /yang yig skor gsum 'phyugs med gnad rnams ston/ khregs chod yang yig nam mkha' klong yangs kyis/ /ma byas ye zin rtsod bral nyag gcig ston/ /thod rgal yangs yig nam mkha' klong gsal gyis/ /mngon sum nyams len snying po'i don rnams ston/ /gnyis ka'i yang yig nam mkha' klong chen gyis/ /mngon sum ye shes lung don mthun par bshad/ /de yi phyir na dkon pa'i yi ge gsum/ /med du mi rung shin tu gces pas na/ /snying gi dkyil du phur cig sa ma ya/ /sprin phung skor gsum sbyar thabs rgyab yig ste/ /dbang po dman rnams gong mar drang ba'i thabs/ /rang byung bde stong bdud rtsi sprin phung gis/ /bde chen ngang las 'od gsal chen por sbyor/ /rlung gi sbyor ba ye shes sprin phung gis/ /gsal stong gnyis med 'od gsal ngang la sbyor/ /rnam par mi rtog nam mkha' sprin phung gis/ /chos nyid 'od gsal blo 'das chen por sbyor/ /de yi phyir na dkon pa'i ye ge gsum/ /mngon sum sgom pa'i grogs su shin tu gces/ /sgron me skor gsum yang zab gnad rnams ston/ / gzhi snang gsal byed ye shes sgron me yis/ /thog ma'i gnas lugs mched lugs legs par ston/ /dpe don gsal byed 'od gsal sgron ma yis/ / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i nyams len snying po ston/ /nyams len gnad kyi sgron me gsal ba yis/ /snying po'i ye shes gnad du bsnun thabs ston/ /yi ge 'di gsum shin tu gces pas na/ /snying dang mig 'dra med pa'i thabs med pas/ /gcig la gcig 'brel zung du tshogs par bya/

/'di gsum tshogs pa'i skal ldan nyams len can/ /rin chen gser la g.yu yis phra bkod bzhin/ /gang 'dod yid bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /de yi phyir na gnad 'di rab tu gces/ /bdud rtsi skor gsum nyams len snying po ston/ /bdud rtsi ljon shing bla ma'i sgrub thabs kyis/ /'di phyi'i don 'grub dngos grub sprin tshogs sdud/ /bdud rtsi dri med khregs chod thod rgal gnad/ /dus bzhi'i rim pas gnad du bsnun thabs ston/ /bdud rtsi rgyal pos brtul zhugs lam du sdong*/ /nad gdon 'drer snang rkyen ngan chos nyid grol/ /gdod nas byang chub spang blang med par ston/ /gsang chen gnad kyis yi ge 'di gsum ni/ /nyams len sgrub pa'i grogs su med thabs med/ /gnad 'di med par mngon sum bsgoms na yang*/ /yang dag rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rnyed dus med/ /de yi phyir na 'di la nan tan gyis/ /'khor lo skor gsum rtag tu 'od gsal sbyor/ /gnad gsum chos nyid 'khor lo gsang ba yis/ /blta stangs gzigs stangs gnad kyi snying po ston/ /nyin mtshan gnyis med 'od gsal 'khor lo yis/ /dngos dang rmi lam bag chags 'brel rgyun gcod/ / yang zab gnad bsdus ye shes 'khor lo yis/ /nyin mtshan ting 'dzin go rim gsal bar ston/ /yi ge 'di gsum tshig nyung don dril bas/ /nyams len lag khrid snying phyung bkod pas na/ /yang mdzod dmar po'i nang du rgyas thobs la/ /goms shing 'dris pa'i grogs su rtag tu 'grogs/ /gegs sel skor gsum nyams len mthar phyin byed/ /lus kyi gegs sel bdud rtsi'i ljon shing gis/ /'byung bzhi'i nad sel rtsa khams snyoms par byed/ /sgo yi gegs sel sgron ma snang byed kyis/ /'od gsal 'char sgo mig gi gsal thabs byed/ /rig pa'i gegs sel ye shes dri med kyis/ /ting 'dzin skyon sel rig pa'i ye shes ston/ /yi ge 'di gsum med pa'i thabs med pas/

/ nyams su len pa'i grogs su gces par zung*/ /nor bu skor gsum mchog dang thun mong 'grub/ /bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /lta sgom rtogs pa'i byin rlabs dngos grub ster/ /yi dam thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par byed/ /mkha' 'gro'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /las bzhi'i phrin las don gnyis 'grub par byed/ /de yi phyir na dkon pa'i yi ge gsum/ /sgrub pa'i grogs su med du mi rung bas/ /nyin mtshan thun bzhir rtag tu bsgom par bya/ / bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du thob/ /snying po skor gsum yang zab snying po'i don/ /nges don mchog gyur byang chub snying po yis/ /yud tsam nyid la ting 'dzin 'od gsal 'char/ /yang zab mthar thug yid bzhin snying po yis/ /rkyen ngan lam bsgyur bde klong gcig tu 'khyil/ /'pho ba yang zab 'od gsal snying po yis/ /bar do'i 'jigs bral gdod ma'i gnas su sbyong*/ /yi ge 'di gsum yang gsang snying tig gi ི/rgyud lung man ngag snying khu mthar thug pas/ /gzhan la mi ston rang nyid zhe dgas 'grogs/ /dpal be'u sgrom bur gsang ba'i rgyas thob la/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas nyams su len pa gces/ /me long skor gsum 'di phyis don gnyis 'grub/ /ngo sprod snying po dran pa'i me long gis/ /tshe 'dir yid ches bar dor grol bar byed/ /'chi ltas gsal byed dran pa'i me long gis/ /rnal 'byor phung po 'dor ba'i dus tshig 'dzin/ /'chi bslu yang zab dran pa'i me long gis/ /dal 'byor ring gnas tshe 'di'i snang ba ston/ /thabs chen gsang ba'i yi ge 'di gsum ni/ / sgrub pa'i grogs su gces pas yid la zung*/ /de dag rnams ni snyan brgyud yi ge can/ /dpe brgyud snying po'i gdams pa bla na med/ /gtso bor tshe 'dir grol ba'i gnad yin pas/

/skal bzang rnams kyis nyin mtshan brtson par mdzod/ /yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud gsang ba 'di/ /grub mtha' gcig pa'i snyan brgyud dngos yin la/ /gtso bor bar dor grol ba'i gnad ston pas/ / thig le gsang ba'i skor zhes btags na yang*/ /dung yig can las 'di don 'brel bar gsungs/ /de phyir gsang chen don gyi man ngag 'di/ /med du mi rung snying tig grogs su gces/ /snyan brgyud skor gsum bar do'i gdams pa ston/ /snyan brgyud chung du ye shes rang snang gis/ /tshe 'di'i nyams len gtso bor gsal bar byed/ /snyan brgyud 'bring po 'od gsal rang snang gis/ /bar do'i ngo sprod gdams pa gsal bar byed/ /snyan brgyud chen mo nges don rang snang gis/ /de dag kun gyi rgyab chos gsal bar byed/ /gsang chen don gyi yi ge 'di gsum ni/ /gcig la gcig 'brel tshang ba shin tu gces/ /deng sang khyad par snyan brgyud 'di zab pas/ /yang zab snying po'i don 'di nyams su longs/ /bar do'i 'od gsal snying po nges par 'grub/ / de dag rnams kyi chos mdzod 'dzin pa la/ /rgyal ba rig 'dzin rim pas bka' bsgos pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho dpag gi mi lang yang*/ /gtso bor bka' srung gsang chen nges pa la/ /ma mo'i gsang sgrub snying gi spu gri yis/ /rang dang chos srung 'gal byed cham la 'bebs/ /gza' rgod gsang sgrub dug gi spu gri yis/ /pha rol dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog dam can gsang sgrub srog gi spu gri yis/ /gnod byed dgra rnams mngon spyod thabs kyis sgrol/ / de yi phyir na dkon pa'i sgrub yig gsum/ /zhal gdams dmar khrid nyams len bkod pas na/ /dpe la ma bzhag bsnyen sgrub las sbyar 'bad/ /rtag tu mchod bstod bskang gsol mnyes byas pas/ /ci bsam 'phral la yid bzhin 'grub pa yin/ /bdag gis sngon sbyang bla ma mnyes byas shing*/ /rgyud lung man ngag rtog par zhu tig byas/

/tshig don kun shes dmar khrid gnad rnams mthong*/ /phyi nang grub mtha'i don kun thams cad shes/ /gsang sngags gsar rnying gsang chen don rnams shes/ /de yis nges don snying po'i tshul 'dir mkhas/ khyad par mchog gsang rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /gsang chen nges pa'i rgyud rgyal bcu bdun dang*/ /de yi man ngag brgya dang bcu dgu yod/ /shin tu zab pa'i po ti bcu (<a3gt;bzhi)rnams kyis/ /snying po'i bcud bsdus tshig nyung don 'dril ba/ /yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po la/ /chos sde lnga bcu rtsa gcig dag tu byas/ /'dir ni yang zab gnad kun tshang bar ston/ /phyi rabs skal ldan gdams pa don gnyer kun/ /'di las mang nyung gang yang med par zung*/ /mang nyung byung na 'ga' yis bslad pas na/ /rtsa ba'i kha byang dag dang bstun pa gces/ /man ngag snying po snga mas chog na yang*/ /de dag grangs mang kha tshang mthong bar dkon/ /gcig tu ma 'dzom mang zhing khrol bar dka'/ /de phyir deng sang tshe thung 'byor pa chung*/ /skal ldan chos mos brtson pa can don du/ /nyung 'dus don 'grub mthong bar rtogs pa'i gnad/ /yang tig yid bzhin nor bu gsal bar byas/ /chos tshul 'od gsal nyi ma'i snying po 'di/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang po'i rtse mo yis/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ kha byang 'dir bkod chos sde lnga bcu gcig /rig 'dzin bla ma mkha' 'gror bcas pa dang*/ /bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gtad/ khyad par smug nag khros ma'i rgyal mo dang*/ / drang srong chen po gza' mchog rā hu la/ /dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs pa rtsal/ /mthu dpal ldan pa gsum la gnyer du gtad/ /phyi rabs dam med 'phri gzhug byed pa dang*/ /'dra min 'chos shing yi ge bslad pa dang*/ /kun la sgrogs shing gsang sgo 'chol rnams la/ /dam tshig gnyen po chad pa drag tu phob/ /snying phyung mig phrul mi 'dod sna dgu thong*/

/skal ldan rnams la 'go zhing stong grogs mdzod/ /dge ba 'di yis srid pa'i khams gsum po/ / thams cad phyam cig 'khor ba'i mtsho brgal nas/ /gdod ma'i sa la 'gyur med kun tu bzang*/ /bde chen lhun grub chos dbyings rgyal por shog kha byang 'od gsal snying po zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ dpal lha las babs pa'i ri ngogs/ o rgyan rdzong gi dben gnas su bkod pa rdzogs so/ /slob ma bzang po gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyis/ /bskul ba'i ngor ni legs par sbyar ba la/ / mos gus bskyed la snying nas gsol ba thob/ /byin rlabs tshad med rtogs pa khong nas 'char/ /thams cad bzhad gad sgyu ma'i rol mo che/ /ha ha sems dang khos kyang gad mo 'chor/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)kha byang 'od gsal snying po/ -PAGE 276- -PAGE 277- -PAGE 270-
